print.$description: Process CMYK builds for print on coated stock. Converted from the screen hex values with the GRACoL 2013 (CRPC6) profile from color.org, relative colorimetric with black-point compensation; Mauve, which is out of gamut, was chosen by eye from a printed swatch sheet (swatch B3). Values are ink percentages. From 3.0.0 the 25% and 50% tints and the grayscale (Black) tints print as the same percentage of their color's build, proof pending; the 8% and 12% tints of the logo colors and greyLight stay screen only. Uncoated values are not yet approved.

mauve.$description: Hand-picked, not the ICC conversion (31/68/0/0, which prints dull). Screen Mauve #C369C9 cannot be matched exactly in CMYK.

black.$description: Black ink only, for text and line art. No rich black is approved.

grey.$description: Black ink only, matched to the lightness of #949494. Borders and dividers only. Never text.

card.$description: Testimonial card, used with a 1px greyLight outline.

width.$description: One outline. Mauve on White (3.40:1); Black on Mauve or Flame.

size.$description: Proxima Way icons: height beside a step heading (same as space.4). Width follows the icon's shape.

gap.$description: Space between an icon and its heading (same as space.2).

element.$description: Brand v3 expressive elements: the whole circle logo, the standalone star, circle and ring clusters, pattern bleeds. Rules: 08-Feedback/DECISIONS-V3-ELEMENTS.md.

logoMin.$description: Smallest size of the circle logo (Q-09; to be reviewed again).

bleedMinColors.$description: A bled logo shows at least this many of its four colors. Only the deep bleed may show two, never a whole petal.

bleedMinPetalShare.$description: Each counted color shows at least this share of its petal.

ringWeightMin.$description: Ring stroke as a share of the ring diameter. Weights may differ within a composition.

ringWeightMax.$description: Ring stroke as a share of the ring diameter.

grayscaleGapMax.$description: Largest white space between grayscale logos in a pattern, as a share of the logo width.

logoGroundMinRatio.$description: A ground may carry the logo when at least bleedMinColors of its colors reach this contrast against it.

logoClearSpace.$description: Round clear space: a ring around the circle logo, as a share of its diameter. Text, photos, UI, other logos and the page edge stay outside it (a bleed excepted). Approved brand elements follow their own rules and may meet the circle.

eyebrow.$description: Eyebrow label pattern (change request 0003). Eyebrows only: one per section, at most five words. Type the label in sentence case and uppercase it with CSS so screen readers read it naturally. Black on White, White on Black, or White on Teal; Teal is the only logo color that carries White text at 14px. Not for buttons, headings or navigation.
